episodes_scope_exactly_one.name: episodes_scope_exactly_one
episodes_scope_exactly_one.value:
(
        ("episodes"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "episodes"."chat_memory_group_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("episodes"."session_id" IS NULL AND "episodes"."chat_memory_group_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

facts_scope_exactly_one.name: facts_scope_exactly_one
facts_scope_exactly_one.value:
(
        ("facts"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "facts"."chat_memory_group_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("facts"."session_id" IS NULL AND "facts"."chat_memory_group_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

item_instances_one_placement.name: item_instances_one_placement
item_instances_one_placement.value:
(
        (CASE WHEN "item_instances"."holder_participant_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN "item_instances"."location_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN "item_instances"."container_instance_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      ) = 1
